title: Design System: Town of Newcastle Applicant Portal

large-title.purpose: Phone step titles, the phone root list, the home heading.

headline.purpose: Sheet titles, primary button labels on phone.

body-compact.purpose: Question labels, desktop sidebar rows, chips.

group-header.purpose: Uppercase heading above an inset group, as in iOS Settings.

shadows.name: slider-knob
shadows.purpose: The iOS slider knob only; containers take no shadow.

motion.name: pane-push
motion.value: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), translateX(24%) and opacity 0 to rest

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Continue and Start: the only solid teal control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--app-accent, #0C727E); color: var(--app-on-accent, #FFFFFF); min-height: 44px; min-width: 112px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Done in a sheet, Edit, Add: teal text, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); }

components.name: Inset Group
components.description: Grouped inset list with header, hairline rows and footnote.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; background: var(--app-ground, #F2F2F7); padding: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-group-h { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: var(--app-secondary-label, #636366); } .ds-group-rows { background: var(--app-row, #FFFFFF); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); } .ds-group-f { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--app-secondary-label, #636366); }

components.name: Sidebar Step
components.description: Source-list step row with status glyph; current on the selection wash.
components.html: Your lotThe work
components.css: .ds-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 16px 12px; width: 17rem; background: var(--app-grouped-ground, #F2F2F7); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); text-decoration: none; } .ds-step:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1) 60%, transparent); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-current { background: var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Two to four options side by side; selection is a wash and an accent border.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-o { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); background: transparent; color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font-size: 15px; } .ds-seg-o:hover { background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); } .ds-seg-o:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-sel { border-color: var(--app-accent, #0C727E); background: var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1); }

components.name: Choice Tile
components.description: Larger choices as 12px-radius tiles on the row colour.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile { min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--app-separator, #C6C6C8); background: var(--app-row, #FFFFFF); color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font-size: 17px; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); } .ds-tile.ds-sel { border-color: var(--app-accent, #0C727E); background: var(--app-selection, #DCEFF1); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled field on the opaque tertiary fill.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--app-fill, #EEEEF0); color: var(--app-label, #1C1C1E); font: 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--app-accent-text, #0C727E); }

narrative.overview: Apple's System Settings and iOS Settings applied to a Town permit: a source-list sidebar beside a content pane on desktop, a large-title list that pushes steps in on a phone, grouped inset rows and sheets. System type, system greys, and the Town seal's teal in two depths; light and dark follow the device.
keyCharacteristics: Grouped inset lists on a grouped ground
Two panes at 1024px and up, push stack below
One accent hue in two depths

rules.name: The Two Teals Rule
rules.body: Text and control teal is the deep accent (lifted accent-text in dark); the seal teal marks identity and never carries text.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: Selection is the selection wash plus an accent border; solid teal is reserved for the primary button and done glyphs.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: Text is the device's system face at 30/22/17/15/13; no other family is loaded.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Containers never take a drop shadow; depth comes from ground, row and elevated row.

dos: Do put every question of a section in grouped inset rows on one pane.
Do give every interactive element at least 44px of height.
Do use the --app-* variables, never literal hex.
Do show selection with the selection wash and an accent border.
Do keep two panes at 1024px and up, the push stack below.
donts: Don't imitate native window chrome: no traffic lights or fake status bars.
Don't drop-shadow a container; raise a sheet by tone.
Don't set text in the seal teal.
Don't load a web font or display face.
